stem: Mr. Lloyd wants to buy a new television, but he does not have enough money in his bank account to pay for one. Which of these is NOT an option for Mr. Lloyd?

options.label: F
options.text: He can use his credit card to buy the television now.

options.label: G
options.text: He can save money and pay cash for the television at a later date.

options.label: H
options.text: He can use his debit card to buy the television now.

options.label: J
options.text: He can save money and use his debit card to buy the television at a later date.
